question: Avocadox avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
Avocadox
is an independent, 100% Mexican agro-industrial company (legally incorporated as
Avocadox S.A. de C.V.
) based in Michoacán, Mexico. It is led by CEO Edgar Ledesma and Administrative Board President Fernando López Gaitán, operating without a larger foreign parent conglomerate.
